title: Laparo — Risks
description: Complication rates stated plainly, with a source the editor must fill in.

intro.default: Every operation carries risk. These are the complications specific to laparoscopic surgery that you should hear before you consent, not after.

calloutText.default: We publish our own audited figures rather than textbook averages. Until the audit is signed off by the surgical governance committee, these cells stay empty - your surgeon quotes you the number for your operation and your risk profile.
